content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Annu Projects Limited (NSE: ANNU) Annu Projects Reports H1 FY27 Revenue at Rs 35.65 Cr and PAT at Rs 2.29 Cr ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Q2 FY27 Revenue: Rs 15.74 Cr - H1 FY27 Revenue: Rs 35.65 Cr - Q2 FY27 PAT: Rs 1.01 Cr - H1 FY27 PAT: Rs 2.29 Cr - Order Book: Rs 1,018.39 Cr 📌 What happened: ↳ Annu Projects Limited announced its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, reporting an H1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs 7.00 Cr. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Fineotex Chemical Reports Q2 FY27 Consolidated Revenue at ₹391.41 Cr, PAT Up 70.82% YoY
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company reported robust Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results with explicit numeric revenue and PAT growth figures.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Fineotex Chemical Limited (NSE: FCL) Fineotex Chemical Reports Q2 FY27 Consolidated Revenue at ₹391.41 Cr, PAT Up 70.82% YoY ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Q2 Revenue from Operations: ₹391.41 crore (up 169.14% YoY) - Q2 Profit After Tax (PAT): ₹44.55 crore (up 70.82% YoY) - Q2 Operating EBITDA: ₹59.59 crore (up 92.04% YoY) - H1 Revenue from Operations: ₹778.13 crore (up 166.81% YoY) - H1 Profit After Tax (PAT): ₹92.75 crore (up 81.51% YoY) 📌 What happened: ↳ The Board of Directors approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, showcasing significant growth across key operational and financial metrics. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Reports H1 FY27 Consolidated Revenue of Rs. 218 Crores
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company announced H1 FY27 financial results along with strategic updates including hotel divestment, warrant issue, and water park acquisition.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited (NSE: IMAGICAA) Imagicaaworld Entertainment Reports H1 FY27 Consolidated Revenue of Rs. 218 Crores ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - H1 FY27 Revenue from Operations: Rs. 217.99 Crs (up 14.7% YoY) - H1 FY27 EBITDA: Rs. 72.3 Crs (up 13.8% YoY) - H1 FY27 Footfalls: 13.65 Lakhs (up 16.5% YoY) - Novotel Divestment: Approved sale of 287-key hotel at Khopoli to Juniper Hotels for Rs. 248 Crs - Water Park Acquisition: Invested Rs. 50 Crs for 50.002% stake in Mehsana Next Parks (Shanku’s Water Park) 📌 What happened: ↳ Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, alongside corporate restructuring moves including a hotel asset divestment and expansion via water park acquisition. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
